title: Former OpenAI researcher says the Riemann proof matters less than the fact that an AI system can produce it
snippet: Complexity theorist and former OpenAI researcher Scott Aaronson argues that AI's recent math breakthroughs matter far beyond academia. The possible consequences, he writes, range from reshaping the global economy to threatening all life on Earth. He's also "virtually certain" that AI labs are sitting on "one or more bombshells" in cryptography.
